name: GetKpiByCustomer
description: Get KPI metrics per customer from SAP: revenue, order count, AOV, cancellation rate. Trigger when user asks about customer performance, top customers by revenue, or per-client sales analysis. All params optional.

customerIdOrName.description: Customer ID or partial name. Null to return all customers.

fromDate.description: Start date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

toDate.description: End date YYYY-MM-DD. Null if not specified.

salesOrg.description: Sales org filter. Null if not specified.

top.description: Return top N customers by revenue. Null if not specified.
